assets.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: WAVE12 "川霧の渡し場 / River Mist at an Old Ferry" scene 3 master background for a three-hour Japanese ambient sleep film, full-bleed wide 16:9 landscape. This image is the reference from which four other scenes will be edited, so every element must be clear, stable and well defined.
Primary request: Create one polished, restrained photorealistic image of an old rural ferry crossing on a wide, slow river in Japan, at night in late autumn, as low river mist begins to rise from the water. One paper lantern on a wooden post gives the only warm light. One small empty wooden ferry boat is moored at a short timber jetty. This is the visual definition image of the volume, not a generic misty lake postcard.
Scene/backdrop: A wide calm river fills the lower half and more of the frame. From the right edge, a short low jetty of old dark timber on wooden piles reaches out over the water to about fifty-five percent of the frame width. At the end of the jetty stands one weathered wooden post, at roughly sixty to sixty-five percent of the frame width. A small, plain, empty, flat-bottomed wooden boat is moored alongside the jetty with its bow pointing toward the left, between about forty-eight and sixty-five percent of the frame width. A few old mooring piles stand in the shallow water near the jetty. Beyond the river, the far bank is a long low dark line of reeds and trees, and behind it soft layered hills fade into a low, even overcast sky. Thin layers of mist drift low over the water, thicker toward the far bank, while the far hills remain visible as soft silhouettes.
Subject: One small traditional Japanese paper lantern, plain with no writing, hangs from the top of the wooden post and glows warm amber. Its long soft reflection falls straight down across the still water toward the camera. The lantern and the boat must be distinct and clearly placed, because their positions will be held fixed in every later scene.
Style/medium: Highly natural cinematic night photography on a tripod, long exposure that smooths the water, believable rural Japanese river atmosphere, restrained realism, gentle telephoto compression. Not an illustration, not anime, not fantasy, not a poster, not HDR.
Composition/framing: The camera is very low, just above the surface of the water, out on the river, looking toward the jetty and the far bank, wide 16:9. The whole foreground and at least the lower half of the frame is unbroken water with no shore, pebbles or ground in the foreground. The LEFT THIRD holds only still water, low mist and the faint far bank — no lantern, no boat and no jetty in it — so it stays calm negative space for a later title; add no text. The jetty, post, lantern and boat sit from the centre to the right so that a later 9:16 portrait crop taken around sixty to sixty-five percent of the width contains the lantern, the bow of the boat and the end of the jetty.
Lighting/mood: Night under a thin overcast. The only light sources are the one lantern and the faint cool blue-grey glow of the sky diffused in the mist. Warm amber lantern light against cool blue-grey mist and dark water. Calm, hushed, soft, lonely but gentle, premium, sleepy. Keep tones READABLE: the timber grain, the boat planks, the piles and the far hills must stay visible; no flat grey fog over the whole frame and no crushed featureless black. The lantern must not clip to a large white blob: keep it as a small warm glow with the paper and frame visible.
Materials/textures: Still dark water with only the faintest ripples, old grey-brown timber, weathered boat planks, a plain rope mooring line, washi paper lantern, soft layered mist, dry late-autumn reeds on the far bank.
Constraints: No moon, no stars, no visible sun, no people, no boatman, no oar in use, no cargo, no footprints, no umbrellas, no hands, no animals, no birds, no bridge, no cars, no electric poles, no power lines, no city lights, no other lanterns, no lit windows, no signboards, no notice boards, no name plates, no readable characters, no text, no logo, no watermark, no snow, no cherry blossom, no red autumn leaves, no bamboo, no torii, no temple, no pagoda, no bokeh balls, no lens flare, no light rays, no sparkle, no strong vignette.
Output intent: A calm reference image whose geometry — jetty, piles, post, lantern, boat, far bank and hills — will be kept pixel-identical while light and mist are changed in four later scenes.

assets.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural

Primary request: Create one photorealistic thumbnail image of an old ferry crossing on a wide Japanese river at night, with one warm paper lantern on a wooden post, its long reflection on still dark water, one small empty wooden boat moored at a short timber jetty, and soft low mist behind, composed so that a two-line title can sit in the left third.
Scene/backdrop: A quiet river in late autumn. The LEFT THIRD of the frame is filled by dark still water and the deep shadow of near dry reeds, reading as dark blue-grey with faint texture. The jetty, lantern and boat occupy the centre and right, with soft layered mist and dim hills behind.
Subject: One plain washi paper lantern with no writing, hanging from a weathered wooden post, and one small empty flat-bottomed wooden boat tied beside the jetty.

Lighting/mood: Warm amber lantern light against cool blue-grey mist, hushed and gentle. Keep the left third dark but not pure black. The lantern must not clip to a large white blob.
Materials/textures: Still dark water, old timber, weathered boat planks, washi paper, soft low mist, dry reeds.
Constraints: No moon, stars, people, boatman, animals, birds, bridge, signboards, readable characters, text, logo, watermark, electric poles, power lines, city lights, other lights, snow, cherry blossom, red autumn leaves, bamboo, torii, temple, bokeh balls, lens flare, light rays or sparkle.

measurement_method.luma: Encoded sRGB 8-bit RGB: Yprime=0.2126 R+0.7152 G+0.0722 B, float64, no rounding before thresholds. Percent units are 0-100.
measurement_method.thumbnail: Pillow LANCZOS to 168x95, compute Yprime, median of columns 0 through 55 inclusive over all 95 rows.
measurement_method.resize: Pillow LANCZOS from 1672x941 to 1920x1080; no cropping or padding.
measurement_method.exposure: Decode IEC sRGB to linear RGB, multiply all channels by one constant global gain, clip to [0,1], encode IEC sRGB, round to uint8 using numpy.rint. Geometry unchanged.
